start.name_zh: 柳州分输站（柳南区太阳村镇新圩村）
start.name_en: Liuzhou Distribution Station (Xinxu Village, Taiyangcun Town, Liunan District) -- expanded under this project
start.geocode_source: Nominatim query '新圩村,柳南区' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E6%96%B0%E5%9C%A9%E6%9D%91%2C%E6%9F%B3%E5%8D%97%E5%8C%BA) -- village-level administrative boundary centroid. Village/town name comes from the gxtngs.com.cn EIA notice ('扩建柳州分输站') describing the project as located in Liunan District & Liucheng County; GEM's own StartLocation field ('Liunan Taiyang Town') matches. This is the same 柳州分输站 station used as the terminus of sibling branch P7673 (Liujiang Branch), per that segment's own sourcing.

end.name_zh: 柳城分输站（柳城县沙浦镇，三北高速柳城服务区西侧）
end.name_en: Liucheng Distribution Station (Shapu Town, Liucheng County, west of the Sanbei Expressway Liucheng service area) -- newly built under this project
end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '沙浦镇,柳城县' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E6%B2%99%E6%B5%A6%E9%95%87%2C%E6%9F%B3%E5%9F%8E%E5%8E%BF) -- town-level administrative boundary centroid. The specific expressway-service-area descriptor comes from GEM's own EndLocation field ('柳城县沙浦镇三北高速柳城服务区西侧的柳城分输站'); county-level existence of a new '柳城分输站' is independently confirmed by liucheng.gov.cn ('新建柳城分输站') and gxtngs.com.cn ('新建柳城分输站、洛满阀室和社冲阀室').

corridor_notes: ~45-46km branch line linking the Liuzhou distribution station (Taiyangcun Town, Liunan District) to a newly built Liucheng distribution station (Shapu Town, Liucheng County), passing through the Luoman (洛满) and Shechong (社冲) valve chambers en route. Per liucheng.gov.cn, ~28km of the route lies within Liucheng County itself; per gxtngs.com.cn, total new pipeline is ~46km across both Liunan District and Liucheng County (close to GEM's LengthKnown=45km). Design pressure ~4 MPa per GEM.
researcher_notes: Builds on the prior pilot pass, which already established existence/route/length via these same three refs (all three originally-cited sheet refs -- njsggzy.cn, fgw.gxzf.gov.cn, fgw.liuzhou.gov.cn -- are dead and should be swapped for these). This pass re-verified all three refs live via url_verifier.py and re-fetched the two gxtngs.com.cn EIA notices directly (raw curl, not AI-summarized) to confirm the literal route/station text: '本工程位于柳州市柳南区和柳城县，新建管道线路全长约46km，扩建柳州分输站，新建柳城分输站、洛满阀室和社冲阀室。' Diameter (323.9mm), capacity, pressure, cost, and exact proposal/construction/start dates remain unconfirmed by any live source (pilot's separate spec-concern entry) -- out of scope for endpoint geocoding but flagged for the record. Endpoint precision: start resolved to village level (新圩村), matching P7673's shared origin station; end resolved to town level (沙浦镇), with the more specific expressway-service-area descriptor sourced from GEM's own field rather than an independently found document.
